name: Adult Blue Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If fails save, can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two attacks: one bite + two claws OR one with lightning breath as bonus.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.text: Each creature within 120 ft: WIS save DC 16 or frightened 1 min.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: 90-ft line, 5 ft wide: 16 (5d6) lightning. DC 17 DEX half.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: Flies up to half speed; each creature within 15 ft: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning. DC 17 STR or prone + push 10 ft.
